name: web-lab-sdk
description: Auth, payments, and wallet facades for Web Game Lab. Design and skeleton only.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/core && npm run build --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/auth && npm run build --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/payments && npm run build --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/web3
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/auth && npm run typecheck --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/payments && npm run typecheck --workspace=@web-lab-sdk/web3
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test --workspaces --if-present && node --test test/environments.test.mjs
